WITH input AS (
  SELECT :actor_id AS actor_id, :group_id AS group_id, :search_term AS search_term,
         COALESCE(TO_TIMESTAMP(:window_end, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF6'),
                  CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)) AS end_at
  FROM dual
), scope AS (
  SELECT g.group_id, i.actor_id, i.search_term, i.end_at,
         i.end_at - NUMTODSINTERVAL(:lookback_days, 'DAY') AS start_at
  FROM input i
  JOIN n_groups g ON g.group_id = i.group_id
  JOIN n_users actor ON actor.user_id = i.actor_id AND actor.is_active = 1
  JOIN n_group_members membership ON membership.group_id = g.group_id AND membership.user_id = i.actor_id
    AND membership.status = 'active' AND membership.role IN ('owner', 'admin')
  WHERE g.privacy = 'public' AND g.is_active = 1 AND g.is_deleted = 0
), blocked AS (
  SELECT b.target_user_id AS user_id FROM n_user_blocks b JOIN scope s ON b.user_id = s.actor_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.user_id FROM n_user_blocks b JOIN scope s ON b.target_user_id = s.actor_id
), visible_posts AS (
  SELECT p.post_id, p.created_at, p.content, s.start_at, s.end_at
  FROM scope s
  JOIN n_group_posts p ON p.group_id = s.group_id AND p.is_deleted = 0
  JOIN n_users u ON u.user_id = p.author_id AND u.is_active = 1
  WHERE p.created_at < s.end_at
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM blocked b WHERE b.user_id = p.author_id)
), activity AS (
  SELECT 'post' AS kind, p.post_id AS source_id, p.post_id, p.created_at, p.content
  FROM visible_posts p WHERE p.created_at >= p.start_at
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'comment', c.comment_id, c.post_id, c.created_at, c.content
  FROM visible_posts p
  JOIN n_group_comments c ON c.post_id = p.post_id AND c.is_deleted = 0
  JOIN n_users u ON u.user_id = c.author_id AND u.is_active = 1
  WHERE c.created_at >= p.start_at AND c.created_at < p.end_at
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM blocked b WHERE b.user_id = c.author_id)
), counts AS (
  SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN kind = 'post' THEN 1 END) AS posts_count,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN kind = 'comment' THEN 1 END) AS comments_count
  FROM activity
), matches AS (
  SELECT a.kind, a.source_id, a.post_id, a.content, a.created_at, s.search_term,
         INSTR(a.content, s.search_term) AS match_at
  FROM activity a CROSS JOIN scope s
), examples AS (
  SELECT m.kind, m.source_id, m.post_id,
         SUBSTR(m.content, CASE
           WHEN :match_excerpt = 1 AND m.match_at + LENGTH(m.search_term) - 1 > 400
             THEN m.match_at - 80
           ELSE 1 END, 400) AS excerpt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, m.kind DESC, m.source_id DESC) AS position
  FROM matches m
  WHERE m.search_term IS NULL OR m.match_at > 0
)
SELECT TO_CHAR(s.start_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF6') AS window_start,
       TO_CHAR(s.end_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF6') AS window_end,
       c.posts_count, c.comments_count, e.kind, e.source_id, e.post_id, e.excerpt
FROM scope s CROSS JOIN counts c
LEFT JOIN examples e ON e.position <= 8
ORDER BY e.position
